edits.draft: Ten thousand people. / Homes, schools, a clinic, parks, and streets to walk along.
edits.c-r1: Ten thousand people, with homes, schools, a clinic, parks, and streets to walk along.
edits.why: Kokoro output of a 2-3-word sentence fell below the 1.5 words/s speech check (1.43 words/s, deterministic seed); merged with its neighbour instead of loosening the check

edits.draft: Power first. / At Schoonschip, forty-six households share a single connection to the national grid,
edits.c-r1: Power first: at Schoonschip, forty-six households share a single connection to the national grid,

edits.draft: ... or develop alternatives of its own. / Ours connects.
edits.c-r1: ... or develop alternatives of its own, / and ours connects.
American spelling (meter, ton, story, neighborhood, gray) and digits for numbers of 100 and more, as in the Studio's other films; 'and ours connects' -> 'and our city connects'
edits.why: ASR check: Whisper writes American spelling and digits, so British spelling and spelled-out large numbers failed the word-error check although the speech was right; 'ours' was heard as 'hours'. Meaning unchanged.

edits.c-r1: One, for 12,000 people off the coast of Busan in South Korea, was unveiled in 2022. / When we checked the developer's and the architects' websites in November 2026, neither reported that construction had begun.

edits.why: owner: the research process made the opening read like a report; the architects' page lists the status 'In Design' (CLM_034)
